facts.fact: Child Helpline 1098 and emergency number 112 are the helplines listed on the Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat portal for reporting
facts.quote: WHL : 181 CHL : 1098 Legal (NALSA) Helpline : 15100 Tele Law : 14454 For Emergency : 112

facts.fact: Child Helpline 1098 is national, 24x7 and toll-free
facts.quote: national toll free 24x7 helpline number dedicated for children in difficult situations.

facts.fact: Call 112 if the marriage is happening now or needs immediate police action (112 is the emergency number)
facts.quote: Tele Law : 14454 For Emergency : 112 Skip to main content

facts.fact: The Child Marriage Prohibition Officer (CMPO) of the area can be approached; CMPO details are made public under the Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat campaign
facts.quote: Enhance public access to details of CMPOs: Increase transparency and accessibility by making comprehensive information about Child Marriage Prohibition Officers (CMPOs) available to the public, facilitating better communication and support.

facts.fact: A complaint can be filed online via 'Report Child Marriage' on the Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat portal (stopchildmarriage.wcd.gov.in/publicComplaint), addressed to the area's CMPO
facts.quote: Gram Panchayat -- Select -- CMPO * -- Select -- Captcha Code Submit

facts.fact: A complaint can also be registered through the Mission Shakti app
facts.quote: Get the Mission Shakti App Register your complaint and take the pledge seamlessly with the Mission Shakti App.

facts.fact: Child marriage is prohibited under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 (PCMA)
facts.quote: Judgement, SUPREME COURT OF INDIA PCMA, Act 2006 NALSA - Training Module for PLVs

summary: Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat portal confirms 1098/112, CMPO details, online 'Report Child Marriage' form (to CMPO), Mission Shakti app and PCMA 2006; 1098 24x7 toll-free from the Child Helpline SOP.
